title: Strongly small-2 sets that are not Riesz sets on compact abelian groups
summary: We prove that every infinite compact abelian group $G$ admits a countably infinite proper set $E\subset\widehat G$ that is strongly small-2 but not Riesz. More precisely, $|α|*|β|$ is absolutely continuous for all $α,β\in M_E(G)$, whereas $M_E(G)$ contains a singular complex measure of total mass one with exact Fourier support $E$ whose convolution square belongs to $L^2(G)$. When the image of the doubling map on $\widehat G$ is infinite, $E$ may moreover be chosen so that $\#(E\cap(γ-E))<\infty$ for every $γ$ and $E\cap(-E)=\{0\}$.
